services.title: ICA Certified Home Inspections
services.blurb: Home inspections for any homeowner: buying, selling, or simply maintaining your home. A visual inspection of the home's readily accessible systems and components, including structure, roof, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC, with a clear, photo-rich report.
services.scope: Visual inspection of readily accessible systems and components. Non-invasive, and not a guarantee or warranty.
